items.title: Pay invoice for leaf removal and gutter cleaning
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung.
items.computation: The invoice sets a 10-day payment period running from 'Erhalt dieser Rechnung' (receipt of this invoice), not from a printed invoice date. The letter itself carries no document date, and no date of actual receipt was given by the recipient, so the start of the 10-day period cannot be fixed. Under §§ 187, 188 BGB the period would start the day after receipt and end 10 days later (shifted to the next business day if it fell on a weekend or public holiday in NW), but without a known receipt date no end date can be computed.

warnings: The invoice has no printed invoice date and the letter does not state when it was received, so the 10-day payment deadline ('innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung') cannot be computed exactly — the person should note the date they actually received the letter and count 10 days from the following day.

Before paying, double-check that the IBAN (DE78 3705 0198 0005 5141 40) and account holder name match 'Hausmeisterservice Beispielhand' as known from earlier contact, since a well-formed IBAN alone does not prove who owns the account.
